Where the codecs come from
==========================

Repository: https://github.com/TheThingsNetwork/lorawan-devices
Commit:     900afb52024f795f073ee4192d845af12d2168d0 (master, committed 2026-10-09)

No file of that repository is kept here. It has no LICENSE file (its
package.json declares Apache-2.0), so the test fetches the files it needs
at test time, from raw.githubusercontent.com at that commit, into the user
cache directory, and checks each against files.sha256. files.sha256 lists
the 123 files by their upstream path with their SHA-256: 57 codec YAML
files from 11 makers (adeunis 4, browan 4, decentlab 6, dragino 8, elsys 5,
mclimate 4, milesight-iot 8, netvox 6, sensecap 4, tektelic 4, watteco 4)
and every JavaScript file they name. They were chosen as popular makers
whose codec files carry examples; two sensecap files have no examples and
are only loaded.

Run:  SIGMA_JSCODEC_TTN=1 go test -v ./...
      SIGMA_JSCODEC_TTN=/path/to/lorawan-devices go test -v ./...   (a checkout of that commit)

Without SIGMA_JSCODEC_TTN, or when the files cannot be fetched, the tests
are skipped with a message saying so.
